final: WITH g AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount ELSE NULL END) AS gavg FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), f AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(gavg) AS favg FROM g GROUP BY frequency) SELECT g.account_id, g.frequency, g.gavg, g.gavg * 1.0 / f.favg AS quotient FROM g JOIN f ON g.frequency = f.frequency ORDER BY (g.gavg * 1.0 / f.favg) IS NULL, g.gavg * 1.0 / f.favg DESC LIMIT 10
